# NFL Daily — 2026-08-06 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 08/06: Colts signed RB Jonathan Taylor to a two-year, $44M extension ($39M guaranteed). [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49544515/jonathan-taylor-agree-2-year-44m-extension-colts) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2085443538028777788)
- 08/06: Commanders signed free agent WR Stefon Diggs to a one-year deal worth up to $12M. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49539100/stefon-diggs-washington-commanders-signing-contract-questions)
- 08/05: Falcons signed RB Bijan Robinson to an extension and re-signed WR Drake London, TE Kyle Pitts and OL Matthew Bergeron. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49528788/atlanta-falcons-sign-bijan-robinson-offensive-core-put-spotlight-qb)
- 08/06: Falcons EDGE Jalon Walker will miss the 2026 season with a torn ACL. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49531025/sources-falcons-jalon-walker-feared-torn-acl)
- 08/06: Texans signed LB Henry To'oTo'o to a two-year, $16M extension. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49545640/sources-texans-lb-henry-tootoo-agree-two-year-extension) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2085396862677184943)
- 08/06: Former Rams DT Aaron Donald worked out for the team as a potential comeback gains momentum. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/aaron-donald-rams-work-out-nfl-return/)
- 08/06: Buccaneers GM Jason Licht said there are "no plans" to trade DT Vita Vea, with Baker Mayfield remaining the starting QB. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49546042/bucs-gm-says-no-plans-vita-vea-trade-baker-mayfield-franchise-qb)
